Thanks Marissa / Alice. A few details from the controls side:

- Interview length: 45 minutes is ideal; 30 min for SMEs where the scope is narrow is OK.
- Owners & tentative availability (will finalize Monday):
  * Priyom Das — Controls governance & logging (Aug 2–3 mornings)
  * Kimberly Park — Configuration/change controls (Aug 4–5 afternoons)
  * Marissa Cole — Procurement/vendor boundary & contracts (Aug 2 afternoon)
  * Grace O'Connor — Data classification & privacy controls (Aug 3 all day)

- Evidence cadence: We'll snapshot the evidence index each Tuesday and push package uploads to the shared Drive on Wednesdays. Bright Compliance will handle ingest and metadata tagging.

Questions for Acme:
1) For SIG: Do you want our control narratives inline in the spreadsheet or as separate PDFs linked in the SIG row? Inline keeps everything in one file; PDFs make versioning easier.
2) For FedAssess: do you require raw logs for a 30-day window or sampled extracts? We can do either but need to know in advance for extraction timing.

I'll own coordinating the uploads and the interview schedule.

-Priyom
Priyom Das
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks — this helps. Quick clarifications:

- SIG narrative format: please include the short control narrative inline (1–3 sentences) in column G and attach a PDF with screenshots or config extracts in the row link. That hybrid approach works best for us.
- Logs: FedAssess wants 30 days of raw syslog (UTC) for the period June 1–June 30 for baseline sampling. If you can provide extracts in the CSV format they shared that would speed validation.
- Interview blocks: can you make the morning blocks start at 9am ET to accommodate our east-coast SMEs?

We'll plan to consume the first SIG upload the week of June 8. Bright Compliance will confirm ingestion once they see the Drive folder.

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to the grid on Monday.

Best,
Alice
